explanation: Explanation for IT ሰኔ #93: Differential backups save all modified data since last full backup.

question_text: [IT ሰኔ Exam 2017 - #94] (Linux Admin) Which octal permission code grants read, write, and execute to owner ONLY (rwx------)? (IT Question Variant #94)
explanation: Explanation for IT ሰኔ #94: Octal 700 specifies rwx for owner and zero permissions for group/others.

question_text: [IT ሰኔ Exam 2017 - #95] (Enterprise Networks) Which protocol tag adds a 4-byte header for VLAN identification in Ethernet frames? (IT Question Variant #95)
explanation: Explanation for IT ሰኔ #95: IEEE 802.1Q is standard VLAN tagging protocol.

question_text: [IT ሰኔ Exam 2017 - #96] (Cloud Models) Which model provides end-user cloud applications like Gmail or Office 365? (IT Question Variant #96)
explanation: Explanation for IT ሰኔ #96: SaaS provides ready-to-use software applications online.

subject: IT
question_text: [IT ሰኔ Exam 2017 - #97] (Database Systems) Which database backup approach copies only data changed since the last incremental backup? (IT Question Variant #97)
explanation: Explanation for IT ሰኔ #97: Incremental backup copies only data altered since the most recent backup step.

question_text: [IT ሰኔ Exam 2017 - #98] (IT Project Management) In IT project management, what diagram maps project tasks over a chronological timeline? (IT Question Variant #98)
explanation: Explanation for IT ሰኔ #98: Gantt charts visually track task schedules across time.

subject: IT
question_text: [IT ሰኔ Exam 2017 - #99] (Network Diagnostics) Which command utility traces the hop-by-hop path taken by packets to a destination IP? (IT Question Variant #99)
explanation: Explanation for IT ሰኔ #99: traceroute/tracert identifies intermediate router hops along packet path.

subject: IT
question_text: [IT ሰኔ Exam 2017 - #100] (Disaster Recovery) What metric defines maximum acceptable duration of data loss measured in time during a disaster? (IT Question Variant #100)
explanation: Explanation for IT ሰኔ #100: RPO measures acceptable data loss window prior to incident.
